title: SM Current Controller
text: 离散时间同步电机电流 PI 控制器，输入 6 路、输出 1 路；按 {Axis prioritization} 指定电压限幅器的轴优先级；{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间、{Discretization sample time} 指定模块离散化采样时间、{Enable zero cancellation} 指定前馈零点对消、{Enable pre-control voltage} 指定预控制电压、{D-axis current proportional gain} 指定 D 轴比例增益、{D-axis current integral gain} 指定 D 轴积分增益、{D-axis current anti-windup gain} 指定 D 轴抗积分饱和增益、{Q-axis current proportional gain} 指定 Q 轴比例增益、{Q-axis current integral gain} 指定 Q 轴积分增益、{Q-axis current anti-windup gain} 指定 Q 轴抗积分饱和增益、{Field current proportional gain} 指定励磁电流比例增益、{Field current integral gain} 指定励磁电流积分增益、{Field current anti-windup gain} 指定励磁电流抗饱和增益，按实例取值。

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Discretization sample time
params.values: 模块离散化采样时间 0.001 (default) | -1 or positive number

params.name: Axis prioritization
params.values: 电压限幅器的轴优先级 q-axis (default) | d-axis | d-q equivalence

params.name: Enable zero cancellation
params.values: 前馈零点对消 off (default) | on

params.name: D-axis current proportional gain
params.values: D 轴比例增益 1 (default) | positive number

params.name: D-axis current integral gain
params.values: D 轴积分增益 100 (default) | positive number

params.name: D-axis current anti-windup gain
params.values: D 轴抗积分饱和增益 1 (default) | positive number

params.name: Q-axis current proportional gain
params.values: Q 轴比例增益 1 (default) | positive number

params.name: Q-axis current integral gain
params.values: Q 轴积分增益 100 (default) | positive number

params.name: Q-axis current anti-windup gain
params.values: Q 轴抗积分饱和增益 1 (default) | positive number

params.name: Field current proportional gain
params.values: 励磁电流比例增益 9 (default) | positive number

params.name: Field current integral gain
params.values: 励磁电流积分增益 350 (default) | positive number

params.name: Field current anti-windup gain
params.values: 励磁电流抗饱和增益 1 (default) | positive number
